HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PUNEET GUPTA, JUDGE.

The short grievance projected by the petitioners in this petition is that the Collector Defence Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue) Baramulla, has passed an award bearing No. ACR/LA/Award/2014/20(II) dated 22nd May 2014, awarding compensation to the petitioners and other interested persons for the land and the trees acquired for defence purposes.

entities.text: Collector Defence Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the amount of compensation awarded, the petitioners moved an application before the Collector Baramulla on 23rd May 2015 seeking reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act to the District Judge, Baramulla but the said application was not decided one way or the other, thus forcing the petitioners to approach this Court by way of the instant petition.
The respondents have filed their objections, stating therein that passing of the award dated 22nd May 2014 is not disputed.
The Collector Land Acquisition has, however chosen not to file any objections.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The short grievance projected by the petitioners in this petition is that the Collector Defence Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue) Baramulla, has passed an award bearing No. ACR/LA/Award/2014/20(II) dated 22nd May 2014, awarding compensation to the petitioners and other interested persons for the land and the trees acquired for defence purposes.
Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the amount of compensation awarded, the petitioners moved an application before the Collector Baramulla on 23rd May 2015 seeking reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act to the District Judge, Baramulla but the said application was not decided one way or the other, thus forcing the petitioners to approach this Court by way of the instant petition.
opennyai_summary.decision: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and regard being had to the nature of controversy involved, this petition is disposed of by directing Respondent-Collector Defence Land Acquisition (ACR) Baramulla, to take up the application dated 23rd May 2015 if filed by the petitioners and pass appropriate orders thereon if not already passed, in accordance with provisions of Section 18 of Jammu & Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, within a period of four weeks from the date copy of this order is served upon him.
